mocca-by-the-sea.title: Mocca by the Sea
mocca-by-the-sea.description: Ideal for a relaxing seaside stay, just steps from the beach with easy access to nearby amenities.

item-1.title: Car charging station ~80 m
item-1.description: At 80 meters, a charging station serves electric vehicles, providing a practical and reliable solution for convenient daily transportation without hassle.

item-2.title: Agia Paraskevi beach ~100 m
item-2.description: Just 100 meters away, Agia Paraskevi Beach offers clear waters and ideal conditions for relaxation, swimming, and sunbathing by the sea.

item-3.title: Closest restaurant ~100 m
item-3.description: Within 100 meters, the nearest restaurant offers a pleasant dining experience with a selection of local and international dishes in a comfortable setting.

item-4.title: Alexandroupoli ~14 km
item-4.description: At a distance of 14 km, Alexandroupoli combines modern amenities with local character, featuring a lively seafront, restaurants, and shops for visitors to explore.

item-5.title: Airport ~20 km
item-5.description: Dimokritos Airport, located 20 km from the properties, offers convenient access for domestic and international travelers, ensuring smooth and comfortable arrivals and departures.

mocca-city.title: Mocca City
mocca-city.description: Perfect for staying in the heart of Alexandroupoli, with everything within walking distance.

item-1.title: City center
item-1.description: Located directly on Dimokratias Avenue, the apartment sits in the very center of Alexandroupoli, surrounded by shops, cafes, and everyday amenities, allowing guests to fully experience the city's vibrant atmosphere without the need for transportation.

item-2.title: Bus station ~300 m
item-2.description: The central bus station is just a short walk away, offering easy and reliable connections to nearby areas and regional destinations, making day trips simple and accessible.

item-3.title: Seafront promenade ~500 m
item-3.description: Within a short and pleasant walk, guests can reach the city’s seafront promenade, ideal for relaxing strolls, seaside dining, and enjoying the coastal atmosphere that defines Alexandroupoli.

item-4.title: Port of Alexandroupoli ~1 km
item-4.description: Approximately 1 km away, the port area offers a lively setting with restaurants, cafes, and connections to nearby destinations, making it a great spot for both leisure and exploration.

item-5.title: Airport ~7 km
item-5.description: Located around 7 km from the apartment, Dimokritos Airport provides convenient access for both arrivals and departures, ensuring a smooth and comfortable travel experience.

terms.title: General terms
terms.description: Our website, moccaliving.com, respects the privacy of your personal information and does not transfer it to third parties, whether individuals or legal entities, except where required by law and to the competent authorities. We reserve the right to disclose personally identifiable information when required by law or when necessary to protect our rights or comply with a court order or other legal process. moccaliving.com maintains records of personal information submitted by visitors solely for communication purposes. Visitors may contact the appropriate department to verify the existence of their personal records and request their correction, amendment, or deletion. Minors may access the website's services only with the consent of their parents or legal guardians and are not required to provide personal information. If we become aware that personal information has been submitted by a minor, our company will delete the relevant information. Our company may process some or all of the information you provide for statistical purposes and to improve the services and information we provide. Our Privacy Policy may be updated from time to time as our business evolves. Your personal information will be used in accordance with the Privacy Policy applicable at the time it was collected.

agreement.title: Terms of Use
agreement.description: Use of the moccaliving.com website and its services constitutes acceptance of these terms of use, which apply to all content, pages, graphics, images, photographs, and files available on the website. Visitors should carefully read these terms before accessing or using the website. If they do not agree with them, they should refrain from using the website's services and content. The content of these pages may be amended from time to time without prior notice. Continued use of the website following any changes constitutes unconditional acceptance of the revised terms.

guest-app.title: Guest app
guest-app.description: Guests staying at our properties can use the guest app on our website during their stay. So that only guests with a valid booking get access, we keep the following details for each booking, taken from the reservation emails we receive from booking platforms and our booking engine, or entered by us: the reservation number, the full name of the person who made the booking, the property, the arrival and departure dates, the number of guests and the booking channel. We do not keep email addresses, phone numbers, postal addresses or payment details. We use these details only to give access to the guest app during the stay (performance of the contract), and they are deleted automatically three days after access ends. When you sign in, a necessary cookie keeps you signed in until access ends, and an irreversibly encoded (hashed) form of your IP address is kept for 15 minutes to prevent abuse. The data is stored in the European Union by our processors Upstash (Frankfurt) and Vercel (hosting, Frankfurt). Reservation emails are received through Resend (Ireland), which keeps a copy of each email for 30 days. You can ask us at info@moccaliving.com to see or delete your details.

content-1.description: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help websites function properly, enhance user experience, and provide analytical insights. Cookies can be categorized into different types based on their purpose:
content-1.bullet-1: Essential Cookies - Required for the website to function properly.
content-1.bullet-2: Performance Cookies - Help analyze how visitors use the website to improve its functionality.
content-1.bullet-3: Functional Cookies - Enhance user experience by remembering preferences (e.g., language settings).
content-1.bullet-4: Marketing Cookies - Used for advertising and tracking user behavior across different websites.

content-2.description: This website uses a single cookie:
content-2.bullet-1: NEXT_LOCALE - This cookie is used for internationalization purposes, ensuring the website displays the correct language based on user preferences.

item-1.title: Smoking prohibited indoors
item-1.description: To ensure a fresh and comfortable environment for all guests, smoking is strictly prohibited inside the property. Guests who wish to smoke may do so in outdoor areas.

item-2.title: Quiet hours & noise policy
item-2.description: To ensure the peace and comfort of all our guests, kindly note that playing music or making loud noises, including raised voices, is strictly prohibited between 14:30 - 17:30 and after 23:00. Your cooperation is essential in maintaining a serene and enjoyable environment for everyone.

item-3.title: Pets are not permitted
item-3.description: We strive to maintain a high standard of cleanliness and comfort for all guests. For this reason, pets are not permitted within the accommodation or on the surrounding property. We kindly ask for your understanding, as this policy helps us ensure an allergy-free environment and preserve the serene atmosphere of the accommodation.

emergency.note: 112 is free to call from any phone.

mini-pool.name: Mini pool
mini-pool.description: A private mini pool with hydromassage, adjustable air flow and underwater colour lighting.
mini-pool.step-1: Shower before entering and make sure the water covers the jets.
mini-pool.step-2: Press the upper blue button once to start the hydromassage.
mini-pool.step-3: Press the lower blue button to switch on the colour lights; press it again to change or stop them.
mini-pool.step-4: Turn the black air control for stronger or softer bubbles. Switch everything off after use.
mini-pool.safety: No soap, oils, glassware, diving or jumping. Children must be supervised by an adult at all times.
mini-pool.cleaning: Remove only loose leaves from the water. We take care of the water treatment, filtration and refills.

smart-tv.name: Smart TV
smart-tv.description: An LG television with streaming apps and HDMI inputs.
smart-tv.step-1: Press POWER on the remote control.
smart-tv.step-2: Press HOME to open the apps.
smart-tv.step-3: Use INPUT only when you connect a device by HDMI.
smart-tv.step-4: Adjust the sound with VOL + and VOL −, and switch the TV off after use.
smart-tv.safety: Please don't unplug cables, sign out of the house accounts or change the network settings.
smart-tv.cleaning: Switch the TV off and use a dry microfibre cloth. Never spray cleaner on the screen.

bluetooth-speaker.name: Bluetooth speaker
bluetooth-speaker.description: A home speaker with Bluetooth, an AUX input and controls for volume, bass and treble.
bluetooth-speaker.step-1: Move the brass POWER switch to ON.
bluetooth-speaker.step-2: Press SOURCE until the Bluetooth light comes on.
bluetooth-speaker.step-3: Hold SOURCE for two seconds until the Bluetooth light flashes.
bluetooth-speaker.step-4: On your phone, open Bluetooth and choose ACTON II. Then set the volume, bass and treble on the speaker.
bluetooth-speaker.safety: Keep the speaker away from water and keep the volume low during quiet hours.
bluetooth-speaker.cleaning: Switch off and unplug the speaker, then clean it with a dry soft cloth.

coffee-machine.name: Coffee machine
coffee-machine.description: A capsule machine for espresso and lungo, with automatic heat-up and power-off.
coffee-machine.step-1: Fill the water tank with fresh drinking water.
coffee-machine.step-2: Press Espresso or Lungo and wait until both lights stay on.
coffee-machine.step-3: Lift the lever, insert one Original capsule and close the lever.
coffee-machine.step-4: Place a cup under the outlet and press Espresso or Lungo.
coffee-machine.safety: Don't lift the lever while coffee is flowing. The outlet and used capsules can be hot.
coffee-machine.cleaning: Empty the used-capsule container and the drip tray. Wipe the machine with a damp cloth; never put it in water.

ceramic-hob.name: Ceramic hob
ceramic-hob.description: A glass ceramic hob with two zones, nine power levels, a timer and a child lock.
ceramic-hob.step-1: Touch and hold the ON/OFF control.
ceramic-hob.step-2: Select the upper or lower cooking zone.
ceramic-hob.step-3: Set the power level with − and +.
ceramic-hob.step-4: After cooking, press ON/OFF and wait until the residual-heat indicator goes off.
ceramic-hob.safety: Use flat-bottomed cookware. The glass stays hot after the hob is switched off.
ceramic-hob.cleaning: Let the glass cool fully, then wipe it with a soft cloth and ceramic hob cleaner. Don't use scouring pads.

cooker-hood.name: Cooker hood
cooker-hood.description: An extractor hood with three fan levels and a light over the hob.
cooker-hood.step-1: Press I, II or III for low, medium or high extraction.
cooker-hood.step-2: Use level III when frying or when there is a lot of steam.
cooker-hood.step-3: Press the light symbol to light the hob.
cooker-hood.step-4: Leave the fan on for five minutes after cooking, then switch it off.
cooker-hood.safety: Never remove or touch the filters while the fan is running.
cooker-hood.cleaning: When the hood is cool, wipe the outside with a soft damp cloth. We clean the filters.

airfryer.name: Air fryer
airfryer.description: A digital air fryer with seven presets, a keep-warm mode and temperatures up to 200 °C.
airfryer.step-1: Place it on a stable surface with at least 10 cm of free space around it.
airfryer.step-2: Put the food in the basket below the MAX line. Never pour oil into the pan.
airfryer.step-3: Press POWER, choose a preset or set the temperature and time, then press START.
airfryer.step-4: Shake the basket halfway through. Unplug the air fryer after use.
airfryer.safety: Hot steam comes out at the back. Keep the air openings clear and handle the basket with care.
airfryer.cleaning: Let it cool for about 30 minutes. Wash the basket and pan with a soft sponge and washing-up liquid.

microwave.name: Microwave
microwave.description: A microwave with grill, combination cooking and a 35-minute timer.
microwave.step-1: Put the food in a microwave-safe glass or ceramic dish.
microwave.step-2: Use the lower dial to choose microwave power, grill or combination.
microwave.step-3: Set the cooking time with the upper timer dial.
microwave.step-4: The microwave starts when the timer is set. To stop it, open the door or turn the timer to 0.
microwave.safety: Never use metal, foil or sealed containers, and never run it empty.
microwave.cleaning: Unplug it and let it cool. Wipe the inside, the door and the turntable with a soft damp cloth.

contact-grill.name: Contact grill
contact-grill.description: A contact grill with adjustable temperature, a grease tray and plates that open flat.
contact-grill.step-1: Make sure the grease tray is in place.
contact-grill.step-2: Turn the thermostat to the heat you need and let the plates preheat.
contact-grill.step-3: Place the food on the lower plate and close the upper plate carefully.
contact-grill.step-4: After cooking, turn the control to OFF, unplug the grill and let it cool.
contact-grill.safety: The plates get very hot. Don't use metal utensils and never put the grill in water.
contact-grill.cleaning: When it's cool, wipe the plates with a soft damp cloth and empty the grease tray.

kettle.name: Kettle
kettle.description: A retro kettle with a temperature gauge, a cordless base and automatic switch-off.
kettle.step-1: Open the lid and fill with water between MIN and MAX.
kettle.step-2: Close the lid and place the kettle firmly on its base.
kettle.step-4: Wait until it switches off by itself, then pour holding only the handle.
kettle.safety: Don't overfill it, don't open the lid while the water boils and don't touch the hot metal body.
kettle.cleaning: Unplug it and let it cool. Wipe the outside; never put the kettle or its base in water.

fridge-freezer.name: Fridge-freezer
fridge-freezer.description: A two-door fridge with the fridge above and the freezer below.
fridge-freezer.step-1: Use the upper compartment for chilled food and drinks.
fridge-freezer.step-2: Use the lower compartment for frozen food.
fridge-freezer.step-3: Leave space around the food so the cold air can circulate.
fridge-freezer.step-4: Close both doors firmly and leave the temperature setting as it is.
fridge-freezer.safety: Don't put hot dishes inside, and never freeze sealed glass bottles with liquid.
fridge-freezer.cleaning: Wipe spills straight away with a soft damp cloth. Never use a knife to remove ice.

washing-machine.name: Washing machine
washing-machine.description: A front-loading washing machine with quick programmes and a door lock.
washing-machine.step-1: Load the drum loosely and close the door firmly.
washing-machine.step-2: Put detergent in compartment II and softener in the flower compartment.
washing-machine.step-3: Press POWER and choose a programme.
washing-machine.step-4: Press START/PAUSE. Open the door only after the lock symbol goes off.
washing-machine.safety: Empty all pockets. Don't wash shoes or anything covered in sand.
washing-machine.cleaning: After use, leave the door slightly open and wipe the rubber seal.

safe.name: Safe
safe.description: An electronic safe with a keypad, a display and a turning handle.
safe.step-1: With the door open, follow the prompt on the display to set your own code.
safe.step-2: Close the door and turn the handle to lock it.
safe.step-3: To open it, enter your code and press the confirm key.
safe.step-4: When the green light comes on, turn the handle and open the door.
safe.safety: If an error message keeps appearing, please contact us.
safe.cleaning: Wipe the keypad and handle with a dry cloth. Don't use liquid cleaners near the electronics.

air-conditioner.name: Air conditioning
air-conditioner.description: A wall air conditioner for cooling and heating, controlled with the remote.
air-conditioner.step-1: Press START/STOP on the remote control.
air-conditioner.step-2: Press MODE to choose cooling, heating, dry or fan.
air-conditioner.step-3: Set the temperature with the arrow buttons.
air-conditioner.step-4: Press START/STOP again to switch it off when you go out.
air-conditioner.safety: Keep the windows and doors closed while it's running.
air-conditioner.cleaning: No cleaning needed. Please tell us if it drips or smells unusual.

smart-tv.name: Smart TV
smart-tv.description: A TCL television with streaming apps.
smart-tv.step-1: Press POWER on the remote control.
smart-tv.step-2: Press HOME to open the apps.
smart-tv.step-3: Use SOURCE only when you connect a device by HDMI.
smart-tv.step-4: Adjust the sound with VOL + and VOL −, and switch the TV off after use.
smart-tv.safety: Please don't unplug cables, sign out of the house accounts or change the network settings.
smart-tv.cleaning: Switch the TV off and use a dry microfibre cloth. Never spray cleaner on the screen.

coffee-machine.name: Coffee machine
coffee-machine.description: A capsule machine for espresso and lungo with Nespresso Original capsules.
coffee-machine.step-1: Fill the water tank with fresh drinking water.
coffee-machine.step-2: Press a coffee button and wait until the lights stop flashing.
coffee-machine.step-3: Lift the lever, insert one capsule and close the lever.
coffee-machine.step-4: Place a cup under the outlet and press the espresso (small cup) or lungo (large cup) button.
coffee-machine.safety: Don't lift the lever while coffee is flowing. The outlet and used capsules can be hot.
coffee-machine.cleaning: Empty the used-capsule container and the drip tray. Wipe the machine with a damp cloth; never put it in water.

turkish-coffee.name: Turkish coffee machine
turkish-coffee.description: A machine that makes traditional Turkish coffee in its own pot.
turkish-coffee.step-1: Fill the pot with cold water up to the mark for the number of cups.
turkish-coffee.step-2: Add one heaped teaspoon of Turkish coffee per cup, and sugar if you like, and stir.
turkish-coffee.step-3: Place the pot in the machine and press the start button.
turkish-coffee.step-4: Wait for the signal that the coffee is ready, then pour it slowly into the cups.
turkish-coffee.safety: The pot gets hot. Don't remove it while the coffee is brewing.
turkish-coffee.cleaning: Rinse the pot with water after each use. Wipe the machine with a damp cloth; never put it in water.

kettle.name: Kettle
kettle.description: A kettle with a touch display and preset temperatures for milk, green tea, coffee, honey and black tea.
kettle.step-1: Fill it with water between MIN and MAX and place it on its base.
kettle.step-2: Touch the power symbol to switch it on.
kettle.step-3: Choose a setting, such as green tea or coffee, or BOIL to boil the water.
kettle.step-4: It switches off by itself when the water reaches the temperature.
kettle.safety: Don't overfill it and don't open the lid while the water is hot.
kettle.cleaning: Unplug it and let it cool. Wipe the outside; never put the kettle or its base in water.

oven.name: Oven
oven.description: A built-in electric oven with several cooking functions, a temperature dial and a digital timer.
oven.step-1: Turn the left dial to choose a function, such as fan or top and bottom heat.
oven.step-2: Turn the right dial to set the temperature.
oven.step-3: Let the oven preheat for about 10 minutes before putting the food in.
oven.step-4: When you have finished, turn both dials back to 0.
oven.safety: The door and the trays get very hot. Use oven gloves.
oven.cleaning: When it's cool, wipe the inside with a soft damp cloth. Don't use scouring pads.

microwave.name: Microwave
microwave.description: A microwave with a power dial and a timer dial.
microwave.step-1: Put the food in a microwave-safe glass or ceramic dish.
microwave.step-2: Use the upper dial to choose the power.
microwave.step-3: Turn the lower dial to set the time; the microwave starts straight away.
microwave.step-4: To stop it, open the door or turn the timer to 0.
microwave.safety: Never use metal, foil or sealed containers, and never run it empty.
microwave.cleaning: Unplug it and let it cool. Wipe the inside, the door and the turntable with a soft damp cloth.

contact-grill.name: Contact grill
contact-grill.description: A contact grill with adjustable temperature and a grease tray.
contact-grill.step-1: Make sure the grease tray is in place.
contact-grill.step-2: Turn the dial to the heat you need and let the plates preheat.
contact-grill.step-3: Place the food on the lower plate and close the upper plate carefully.
contact-grill.step-4: After cooking, turn the dial to OFF, unplug the grill and let it cool.
contact-grill.safety: The plates get very hot. Don't use metal utensils and never put the grill in water.
contact-grill.cleaning: When it's cool, wipe the plates with a soft damp cloth and empty the grease tray.

fridge-freezer.name: Fridge-freezer
fridge-freezer.description: A fridge with the fridge above and the freezer below.
fridge-freezer.step-1: Use the upper compartment for chilled food and drinks.
fridge-freezer.step-2: Use the lower compartment for frozen food.
fridge-freezer.step-3: Leave space around the food so the cold air can circulate.
fridge-freezer.step-4: Close both doors firmly and leave the temperature setting as it is.
fridge-freezer.safety: Don't put hot dishes inside, and never freeze sealed glass bottles with liquid.
fridge-freezer.cleaning: Wipe spills straight away with a soft damp cloth. Never use a knife to remove ice.

dishwasher.name: Dishwasher
dishwasher.description: A built-in dishwasher with several programmes, including eco and quick.
dishwasher.step-1: Scrape off leftovers and load the baskets so the spray arms can turn freely.
dishwasher.step-2: Put one dishwasher tablet in the detergent compartment and close it.
dishwasher.step-3: Press the power button and choose a programme; Eco suits normal loads.
dishwasher.step-4: Close the door and press start. Open it only when the programme has finished.
dishwasher.safety: Don't wash wooden items or pans that aren't dishwasher-safe. Let the steam out before you unload.
dishwasher.cleaning: After the programme, leave the door slightly open so it can dry.

washing-machine.name: Washer-dryer
washing-machine.description: A front-loading washer-dryer with a programme dial, steam and drying.
washing-machine.step-1: Load the drum loosely and close the door firmly.
washing-machine.step-2: Put detergent and softener in the drawer compartments.
washing-machine.step-3: Turn the dial to choose a programme; for drying, choose a drying setting.
washing-machine.step-4: Press Start/Pause. Open the door only after the lock symbol goes off.
washing-machine.safety: Empty all pockets. Don't wash shoes or anything covered in sand.
washing-machine.cleaning: After use, leave the door slightly open and wipe the rubber seal.

safe.name: Safe
safe.description: An electronic safe with a keypad, a display and a turning handle.
safe.step-1: With the door open, follow the prompt on the display to set your own code.
safe.step-2: Close the door and turn the handle to lock it.
safe.step-3: To open it, enter your code and press the confirm key.
safe.step-4: When the green light comes on, turn the handle and open the door.
safe.safety: If an error message keeps appearing, please contact us.
safe.cleaning: Wipe the keypad and handle with a dry cloth. Don't use liquid cleaners near the electronics.
